pages.text: $(bold)Xaero's Minimap$() (top right) and $(bold)World Map$() ($(bold)M$()). Set waypoints for everything.
$(bold)Nature's Compass$(): pick any biome and it points there. Biomes come from Biomes O' Plenty, Geophilic, Climate Rivers and Stony Cliffs.

$(bold)Explorer's Compass$(): the same for structures. Pick a dungeon, tower or city and walk. Hundreds of structure types are in this pack: When Dungeons Arise, YUNG's, Dungeons and Taverns, Stalwart Dungeons, Repurposed Structures, Structory, Explorations, Formations, Moog's Voyager and more.

$(bold)Alex's Mobs$() is everywhere: about 80 animals, most with a use. Craft the $(bold)Animal Dictionary$() to read about them. $(bold)Friends & Foes$() adds the Copper Golem, Moobloom, Glare, Rascal and Iceologer.
